newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares set new record high, closing up 1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares set new record high, closing up 1 pct.

text.p: 1540 GMT - Dutch shares close near high with reinforcement from Wall Street, the strong dollar and a healthy bond market. Individual shares also perform well, with Polygram full year profits at high end of expectations and KNP BT positive about 1997. Royal Dutch and Philips both gain in advance of Thursday's results announcements.
* AEX index ends up 6.86 points, or 0.98 percent, to 705.58 points. Earlier the index set a new intra-day high of 706.05.
* Royal Dutch ends up 5.80 to 335.80. Philips up 4.50 to 78.10.
